sections.content: At low lead volume, Elena recommends starting with sales’ intuition: ask which account signals make them excited about a hand-raiser or sales-form submission, be transparent about the criteria, and initially send accounts that fit that simple model—not every user. Verna cautions that unclear PQA criteria can leave sales to “do their own thing”; she recommends close product–sales collaboration, shared goals, and new communication rituals to keep the teams aligned.
